about: Experience Syphon Filter™ originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Gabe Logan: guerrilla warfare expert, master marksman, and a man on a personal crusade to bring down an international terrorist ring and eliminate a deadly virus…
Syphon Filter exploded onto PlayStation® back in 1999 – now you can experience Logan’s classic first adventure all over again.
Use stealth, reconnaissance, and extreme combat to trace the path of the Syphon Filter virus back to where it all began, and complete your mission by any means necessary…
This title has been converted from the PlayStation® version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features.
Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PlayStation® version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly.
